mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 4.5% signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 4.5%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts above 1000 thousand units and retail sales above 400,000 million dollars signals robust consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS > 400000) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 235), rising CPI signals central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 235, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production index above its 3-month moving average signals strong economic output, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 3-month moving average fails to predict positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1100 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 1100.0, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: Combined low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signal a strong economy with accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: strong economy with loose monetary policy
failure_condition: The joint condition (UNRATE < 4.5% AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 > 16400), high GDP levels signal economic maturity and potential slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 exceeds 16400, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods.
